common.demoBanner: Graduation-project demo system — all data is fully synthetic and does not represent real patients.
common.comingSoon: This section is still being built per the project plan — it activates once its backend module is implemented.

home.title: ClinicCare
home.subtitle: A demo clinic management system — patient records, appointments, and clinical documents, built as a graduation project. All data in the system is synthetic and does not belong to any real patient.
home.sectionsSubtitle: Each section serves a different clinic role, and will later be restricted by role-specific permissions.

auth.loginSubtitle: Session-based auth (not JWT), per section 7 of the technical plan.
auth.backendNotice: Real sign-in will work once the Auth Module is implemented (week 1-2 of the plan). This form is UI-only for now.
auth.demoAccountsNotice: Demo account credentials will be generated by the seed script, using synthetic data only.

reception.title: Reception
reception.description: Patient registration, appointment booking, and prevention of scheduling conflicts.

doctor.title: Doctor workspace
doctor.description: Clinical record, diagnosis (ICD-10), prescriptions, and signing documents (immutable once signed).

portal.title: Patient portal
portal.description: Shows the patient only their own appointments and finalized documents (drafts excluded via a dedicated database view).

admin.title: Admin dashboard
admin.description: Manage users, roles, permissions, and the append-only audit log.
